purpose: Storyboard frame {n} of 6 for a scroll-driven 3D hero animation on a B2B analytics website that connects customer requests, deals and payments and shows where orders get lost.
palette: Palette, strictly: near-black background with a green-teal tint #060B0B; deep teal mid-tones #112922, #243731, #38554F; mint #96EAC0 as the main light; off-white #F1F6F5 only for the very brightest highlights; one warm orange #EE8139 accent reserved for the single important signal, never more than one small orange element in the frame.
avoid: Avoid: ribbons, bands, tubes, worm-like or snake-like shapes, tori, rings, orbits, discs, saucers, portals, any icon or object spinning in the center, planets, galaxies, vortex spirals, brains, DNA, circuit boards, binary code, holographic HUD overlays, charts, people, robots. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark.

compositions.hero: Composition: 16:9-safe framing; the upper 45 percent of the frame is calm, empty dark background reserved for a centered headline and buttons; the scene sits in the lower half, centered, slightly overflowing the bottom edge; nothing important within 6 percent of the left and right edges.
compositions.side: Composition: the scene occupies the right 60 percent of the frame; the left 40 percent stays calm, dark and nearly empty for section copy; horizon slightly below center; 16:9-safe framing.
compositions.ui: Composition: the scene resolves into the right 60 percent of the frame; the left 40 percent stays calm and empty; 16:9-safe framing.
compositions.mobile: Composition: vertical mobile hero; the upper 45 percent is calm, empty dark background reserved for a headline and a button; the scene fills the lower half and slightly overflows the bottom edge; nothing important within 8 percent of the left and right edges.

directions.name: Volumetric light field
directions.concept_ru: Бизнес как тёмное пространство, в котором есть свет. Обращения - редкие точки света в тумане. TURBIUM не добавляет объектов, он проявляет: свет собирается в маршрут, место потери загорается оранжевым. Глубина и воздух, твёрдой геометрии нет. Риск: самое атмосферное и самое абстрактное из трёх, смысл продукта считывается слабее.
directions.style_lock: Look: a vast dark volume of slow, softly lit atmospheric haze with gentle uneven density, glowing from within like light inside fog; tiny rare bright points of light suspended at different depths. Rendered as premium real-time 3D with true volumetric lighting, soft bloom, very subtle film grain, deep contrast, no hard edges and no solid objects. Virtual camera 35mm, slight depth of field. All frames look like one continuous shot of the same scene.

frames.state: Overview. Dozens of faint mint light points scattered at different depths in the haze, each one a separate customer request arriving from its own direction; the haze between them is uneven, with darker voids. Quiet, wide, unresolved.
frames.camera: Wide establishing view from slightly above, static.
frames.motion_ru: 0-10% прокрутки. Туман дышит: плотность меняется с периодом 8-12 с, точки дрейфуют на 2-4 px/с. Курсор: туман светлеет в радиусе ~150 px, точки не убегают.

frames.state: Approach. Closer, inside the haze; the light points drift forward in loose streams, and three faint depth layers appear one behind another, defined only by the density of light in the fog, not by any surfaces: first contact, deal, payment.
frames.camera: Slow dolly forward into the volume.
frames.motion_ru: 10-30%. Камера въезжает на 20-25% глубины, ease-in-out. Слои проявляются плотностью, без резких границ.

frames.state: Signal found. Between the second and third depth layers one stream of light thins out and fades into darkness; exactly at that break a single small orange #EE8139 point glows steadily with a soft halo in the haze, the only warm light in the frame. Everything else dims slightly so the orange point is the clear focal point.
frames.camera: Camera stops and racks focus onto the orange point, shallow depth of field.
frames.motion_ru: 30-45%. Пауза камеры на 0.6-0.8 с прокрутки, перевод фокуса на оранжевую точку за 0.4 с, остальной свет -20%. Точка светится ровно, не мигает: это находка, а не тревога.

frames.state: Deal route. One continuous path of mint light threads through all three depth layers, from a single request point in the foreground to a bright resolved point in the far layer; the path is light scattering in haze, like a beam through fog, not a solid object; the haze along it becomes clearer.
frames.camera: Lateral tracking shot along the path, gentle parallax between layers.
frames.motion_ru: 45-65%. Свет проходит маршрут за 1.2-1.6 с, привязан к прокрутке. Боковой проезд, параллакс слоёв на трёх скоростях.

frames.state: Whole picture connected. Many light paths now pass through the three layers; most reach the far layer and glow mint, a few stop at the same break, which is still marked by the single orange point; the haze has settled and the volume feels calm, legible and ordered.
frames.camera: Pull back to a wide view, slightly higher than the first frame.
frames.motion_ru: 65-85%. Отъезд, маршруты зажигаются волной спереди назад с шагом 80-120 мс. Оранжевая точка остаётся единственной.

frames.state: Transition to interface. The haze compresses and flattens toward the viewer into one soft-edged dark rectangular plane of light, as if the fog condenses into a screen; faint mint light along its edges, the surface itself is empty, ready for an interface screenshot.
frames.camera: Camera turns to face the plane frontally, perspective flattens.
frames.motion_ru: 85-100%. Туман схлопывается в плоскость за 0.8 с, на её место встаёт реальный скриншот интерфейса (вёрстка, не генерация).

directions.name: Optical architecture
directions.concept_ru: Система как точный прибор. Три ряда тонких стеклянных пластин в глубине: обращения, сделки, оплаты. Лучи проходят сквозь них и преломляются. Луч, который не дошёл до третьего ряда, - потерянный заказ. Ощущение инженерной точности, без магии. Риск: стекло легко скатывается в шаблонный «glass UI», держать пластины тонкими и строго прямоугольными.
directions.style_lock: Look: precise optical architecture in a dark studio void: thin rectangular panes of clear glass with polished bevelled edges, arranged in exact rows in depth, catching fine mint light along their edges; thin collimated beams of light pass through the panes and refract cleanly. Rendered as premium product-grade 3D with physically correct glass, subtle caustics and dispersion, crisp focus, deep blacks, only a faint trace of haze. Virtual camera 50mm. All frames look like one continuous shot of the same scene.

frames.state: Overview. Three rows of thin vertical glass panes stand in depth in a dark void, slightly misaligned and rotated, like an instrument not yet assembled; thin mint beams enter from the left at random angles, many miss the panes entirely and fade into darkness.
frames.camera: Wide three-quarter view from slightly above, static.
frames.motion_ru: 0-10%. Пластины покачиваются на 1-2°, период 6-10 с. Курсор: ближайшая пластина доворачивается к нему на 3-5°, лучи смещаются. Сцена целиком не вращается.

frames.state: Approach. The panes rotate into near-alignment; the three rows read clearly as three stages one behind another; beams now hit the first row and split into finer rays.
frames.camera: Slow dolly in with a slight arc to the right.
frames.motion_ru: 10-30%. Пластины выравниваются по прокрутке (ease-out), камера смещается по дуге на 10-15°.

frames.state: Signal found. Inside the second row one beam refracts sharply away and never reaches the third row; at the exact point where it leaves the edge of that glass pane a single small orange #EE8139 glint marks where the beam is lost, the only warm light in the frame.
frames.camera: Close-up on that pane edge, macro-like shallow depth of field.
frames.motion_ru: 30-45%. Наезд на кромку, пауза 0.5 с. Оранжевый блик ровный, без пульсации.

frames.state: Deal route. One beam travels cleanly through all three rows, refracting at each pane and ending as a bright mint point of light behind the third row; the edges of the panes it crosses light up in sequence.
frames.camera: Lateral tracking shot along the beam, panes passing in the foreground with parallax.
frames.motion_ru: 45-65%. Луч проходит три ряда за 1-1.4 с, кромки загораются по очереди с шагом ~150 мс.

frames.state: Whole picture connected. All panes are precisely aligned in a calm orthogonal grid; dozens of parallel beams pass straight through all three rows; a few beams still break at the same place in the second row, marked by the single orange glint.
frames.camera: Pull back to a wide, symmetric, slightly elevated frontal view.
frames.motion_ru: 65-85%. Отъезд, сетка встаёт строго ортогонально: момент «стало понятно».

frames.state: Transition to interface. The rows of glass slide together and merge into one flat pane facing the viewer: a clean dark glass rectangle with a fine mint edge highlight; its surface is empty, ready for an interface screenshot.
frames.camera: Camera faces the merged pane frontally, perspective flattens.
frames.motion_ru: 85-100%. Ряды съезжаются в одну пластину за 0.6-0.8 с, поверх встаёт реальный интерфейс.

directions.name: Movement of the many
directions.concept_ru: Смысл собирается из данных. Тысячи мелких частиц - обращения. Сначала хаос, потом потоки через три зоны. Часть частиц отпадает и гаснет: это потерянные заказы. В финале частицы укладываются в решётку, из которой вырастает отчёт. Прямее всего отвечает на заголовок «Где теряются заказы?». Риск: рой тянется закрутиться в спираль или кольцо, поэтому потоки только прямые и слегка изогнутые.
directions.style_lock: Look: thousands of tiny discrete particles, short glowing dashes and dots of mint light, suspended in a dark void with depth; every particle is a separate element, and flows are always made of many separate particles with visible gaps between them, never a continuous surface or strand. Rendered as premium real-time 3D particle simulation, fine sharp particles, soft bloom only on the brightest ones, depth of field separating near and far particles, deep blacks. Virtual camera 35mm. All frames look like one continuous shot of the same scene.

frames.state: Overview. A loose, uneven cloud of thousands of tiny mint particles scattered across the depth of a dark space, moving in different directions, denser in some areas and sparse in others, with no overall shape and no center.
frames.camera: Wide view from slightly above, static.
frames.motion_ru: 0-10%. Скорость частиц 0.5-2 px/с, 3-8 тыс. на компьютере, 1-2 тыс. на телефоне. Курсор: частицы расступаются в радиусе ~120 px и возвращаются за 1 с. Облако не вращается вокруг центра.

frames.state: Approach. The particles begin to align into several loose parallel streams flowing left to right through three zones one behind another; each zone is suggested only by particles slowing down and clustering, with no walls or objects.
frames.camera: Slow dolly forward into the cloud.
frames.motion_ru: 10-30%. Выравнивание в потоки по прокрутке, скорость частиц растёт до 20-40 px/с. Зоны видны только по замедлению.

frames.state: Signal found. In one stream, after the second zone, a portion of the particles peels away downward, slows and dims to grey-teal #38554F as it falls out of the flow; among them a single small orange #EE8139 particle glows brightly, the only warm element in the frame, marking where orders are lost.
frames.camera: Camera moves close to the break point, shallow depth of field.
frames.motion_ru: 30-45%. Отпавшие частицы падают с ускорением и гаснут за 1.5-2 с. Оранжевая частица отстаёт от остальных и остаётся видна.

frames.state: Deal route. One dense, bright stream of particles travels cleanly through all three zones from left to right and gathers at the far end into a compact bright mint cluster; the stream is direct and purposeful, gently curving, never spiralling.
frames.camera: Lateral tracking shot alongside the stream.
frames.motion_ru: 45-65%. Один поток проходит три зоны за 1.2-1.6 с, привязан к прокрутке.

frames.state: Whole picture connected. Most particles now move in calm, ordered parallel streams through the three zones; a thin trickle still drops out at the same break, marked by the single orange particle; the space is legible and quiet.
frames.camera: Pull back to a wide, elevated view.
frames.motion_ru: 65-85%. Отъезд, потоки установились. В точке разрыва продолжается тонкий отток: потеря идёт постоянно, а не один раз.

frames.state: Transition to interface. The particles settle and lock into a precise flat lattice of points facing the viewer, forming the outline of an empty rectangular panel with neat rows and columns of tiny mint points; no charts, no text.
frames.camera: Camera faces the lattice frontally, perspective flattens.
frames.motion_ru: 85-100%. Частицы укладываются в решётку за 0.8-1 с (задержка 2-4 мс на частицу), затем решётка уступает место реальному интерфейсу.
